# V4: transaction validity (Standard Profile 1)

Generated by gov5 from its own code:
`go test -tags nosqlite,noboltdb ./internal -run TestProfile1VectorV4`
(`N42_PROFILE1_VECTORS_UPDATE=1` rewrites `transactions.json`; `N42_PROFILE1_VECTORS_MIRROR=<dir>` also writes `<dir>/V4/`).
The test fails if the file differs from what gov5 computes.

Each case is one transaction (`raw`, EIP-2718 bytes) judged alone in block 1 (`block`) on the standard genesis
(`internal/testdata/profile1/standard_genesis.json`) plus the funded test sender of V3. `verdict` is `valid` or
`invalid`; `refusedAt` names the first stage that refused, in this order:

1. `decode` - EIP-2718 decoding (types 0x00-0x04 only on the Ethereum wire form).
2. `typeRule` - C1-C4: only 0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x04 are valid on Profile 1.
3. `includable` - the deferred-execution includability check (gas within the block, fee cap, intrinsic gas, initcode cap, EIP-7702 shape).
4. `execution` - the state transition.

Error strings are gov5's and informative only; the verdict is the vector.

| Case | Rule | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| type-0-legacy, type-1-access-list, type-2-dynamic-fee | C1 | valid |
| type-3-blob | C2 | invalid |
| type-4-set-code | C3 | valid |
| type-4-empty-auth-list, type-4-create | C3 | invalid |
| type-5-post-quantum, type-6, type-0x50, type-0x51, type-0x5f | C4 (every other type) | invalid |
| gas-at-block-limit | C5 | valid |
| gas-at-cap, gas-over-cap | C5 | invalid (both exceed the 480M block gas limit) |
| initcode-at-cap (131,072 B) | C6 | valid |
| initcode-over-cap (131,073 B) | C6 | invalid |

Pool policy is a subset (C7): a gov5 Profile-1 pool refuses every invalid case.

## Open point

The EIP-8037 per-transaction cap (2^32-1) is above the Profile-1 block gas limit (480M). gov5's includability check
refuses any transaction whose gas exceeds the block's remaining gas limit, so the cap itself is never the binding
rule on the standard genesis. Whether a transaction with 480M < gas <= 2^32-1 is valid under Amsterdam's split
regular/state gas accounting needs a decision; these files record gov5's current answer (invalid).
